_comment: Schema: RestroomExperimentsFile in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md section 2b. Written by ml/restroom/export_results.py from ml/results/restroom/runs/*.json. Rows with isReal false are placeholders with null metrics ('not run yet'). `reference` holds the numbers published by the IOAI committee on their test set (Leaderboard B); they are not our runs.

reference.note: Published by the IOAI 2025 committee for the Restroom Icon Matching task, top-1 matching accuracy on their test set (Leaderboard B). Not our runs.

runs.changed: baseline: zero-shot CLIP ViT-B/16, second most similar gallery image (IOAI baseline)
backbone: ViT-B/32 instead of ViT-B/16, still zero-shot
fine-tune last 1 block of ViT-B/32, two models, two-step matching (IOAI reference recipe)
ViT-B/32, fine-tune the last 6 transformer blocks (IOAI reference recipe)
R4 plus augmentation (flip, crop, colour jitter)
gender probe: logistic regression on frozen ViT-B/32 embeddings; match = most similar candidate of the opposite predicted gender (the API's rule)
